_guide.matching: Rules are tested from top to bottom. Every field inside one when object must match. The first matching rule supplies the phrase.
_guide.ranges: Use min and max for numbers, equals for text or true/false. Omit either end of a range when it is not needed.
_guide.weatherMetrics: temperature is °C, humidity and cloudCover are %, precipitation is mm, windSpeed is km/h, and windDirection is degrees.
_guide.internetMetrics: rtt is the browser's rounded millisecond estimate; downlink is estimated Mb/s; requestTime is the measured duration of the weather fetch. Some browsers omit rtt and downlink, so requestTime supplies the live fallback.
